name: braintrust
summary: I spent the entire run attempting to locate the vendor's "Evaluation quickstart" page. While I successfully fetched the main start page (`/docs/start`), the docs index (`/docs/llms.txt`), and detailed evaluation reference pages like `/docs/evaluate/run-in-code.md`, every attempt to fetch the actual evaluation quickstart content—via URLs like `/docs/start/evaluation-quickstart`, `/docs/start/eval`, `/docs/guides/eval-quickstart`, and multiple variants—returned empty or null responses. Because I could not retrieve the specific step-by-step quickstart instructions, I never installed the SDK, wrote an eval file, or ran any commands in the sandbox. No eval run was executed and no scores were reported.

env_ready.evidence: Transcript contains only HTTP fetch commands; no sandbox commands were executed to install or verify a runtime or package manager.

installed.evidence: No installation commands (e.g., npm install, pnpm add, pip install) for the Braintrust SDK, CLI, or dependencies appear in the transcript.

configured.evidence: No credential or configuration commands (e.g., setting API keys or .env files) were executed in the sandbox.

first_call.evidence: No eval script was created and no `bt eval` or SDK invocation was run in the sandbox.

verified.evidence: The agent's final note states: 'No eval run was executed and no scores were reported.'

friction.where: Missing evaluation quickstart at canonical URLs
friction.detail: Fetches to `https://www.braintrust.dev/docs/start/evaluation-quickstart` repeatedly returned null or empty responses.
The agent had to guess multiple URL variants such as `/docs/start/eval-quickstart.md`, `/docs/guides/eval-quickstart`, and `/docs/evaluate/quickstart.md`.

friction.where: Python quickstart requires a coding agent
friction.detail: The Python SDK page instructs to run `curl -fsSL https://braintrust.dev/wizard/setup.sh | sh -s -- --from docs_python_quickstart` and adds `No coding agent installed? Install and instrument manually.`
The `bt eval` reference notes: `bt eval is currently macOS and Linux only.`

friction.where: Runnable eval instructions under non-obvious path
friction.detail: Step-by-step eval code instructions were located only under `/docs/evaluate/run-in-code.md` with commands like `pnpm add braintrust openai autoevals`, not under any quickstart path.
